##### Project general facts

Azizi Gabriel by Azizi Developments is an elegant residential building with a stepped contemporary facade, where a dark exterior is complemented by numerous balconies with glass railings and striking linear lighting. Lush landscaping frames the structure and emphasises its refined, modern presence. The building rises above four basement levels, lower and upper ground floors and three podium levels to eleven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units.

Residents enjoy swimming pools for adults and children with a poolside terrace, separate fitness centres for men and women and a private cinema for relaxed evenings. A game room, an indoor multipurpose hall, an indoor children's play area, spacious lounges, recreation zones and social areas add variety, while a welcoming lobby, lifts, parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Residences feature functional layouts and modern interiors in light neutral tones, with refined European-inspired finishes, warm accents and large windows that bring natural light into the living spaces. Efficient floor plans suit professionals and couples who value a practical home close to work. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is one of the leading business and logistics hubs of Dubai, home to Jebel Ali Port, the largest port in the Middle East, and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, where thousands of international companies are based. Residential neighbourhoods, community retail, cafes, schools and clinics sit close to the business district, giving residents a practical setting close to their workplaces.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Dubai Metro Red Line serves the area. Expo City Dubai and Dubai Parks and Resorts are a short drive away, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Ibn Battuta Mall are close by, and Al Maktoum International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable reach.

Jebel Ali offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible entry prices in western Dubai. A large working population in the free zone and the port supports steady demand from tenants seeking homes close to their workplaces. Continued infrastructure investment around Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport underpins attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
